review:
Super Golden Spins is a compact 3×3 slot with nine paylines and a retro neon look. Base-game wins come from three-symbol combinations, with Pragmatic Play listing line wins of up to 700x, so the main grid does more of the work than in most modern releases.

Three scatters anywhere start the wheel bonus. Two independent wheels spin together: one can show cash values up to 100x, the other multipliers up to 27x. Two cash results are added, a cash value and a multiplier combine, and two multipliers multiply each other before applying to the bet. Published RTP is 96.55%. It suits players who like short, simple sessions with one clear bonus to chase.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
